mentions.name: Numbrrs
mentions.description: A flashcard game for learning to recognize NHL players by their jersey numbers. Built as a SvelteKit app, it pulls roster data directly from the NHL to stay up to date with roster changes.
mentions.problem: Existing options for learning NHL jersey numbers, such as Sporcle quizzes, were out of date.
mentions.audience: I decided I wanted to get better at recognizing NHL jersey numbers and was frustrated with the options available to learn (out of date Sporcle quizs and the like)
mentions.source_excerpt:
I decided I wanted to get better at recognizing NHL jersey numbers and was frustrated with the options available to learn (out of date Sporcle quizs and the like), so I tossed together a flashcard game with the help of Claude.

It pulls data directly from the NHL to stay up-to-date with changes to the roster, but is otherwise a pretty straight-forward and basic sveltekit app.
